gen-vast-shadow-gf-glegoo: Glegoo keeps things literate and open, its serif curves wide in the mouth. Vast Shadow's heading letters, cut with a rounded-nib look and no swelling at the ends, give the page a vintage jolt above it.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-hanuman: Vast Shadow draws every letter with one constant stroke from top to baseline. Hanuman, a refined text serif with a high-waisted lowercase, then carries a long page with a traditional, unhurried feel.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-kadwa: Vintage swagger comes first, with Vast Shadow's bowls showing no swelling at all. Kadwa follows as a classic serif with open-ended curves and a big x-height, so a long page reads smoothly and easily.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noticia-text: Think rolling-ball pen lettering, one single-width trail from Vast Shadow, all vintage and eye-catching. And Noticia Text, a dignified serif whose lowercase fills most of the letter height, gives that trail a literary partner with real presence.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-piazzolla: Vast Shadow looks like uniform wire, with no thick or thin parts anywhere in its letters. But Piazzolla, a refined classic serif with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, brings the authority that makes the pairing hold.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-pridi: Horizontal bars exactly as heavy as the upright stems define Vast Shadow, giving it a vintage, eye-catching face. And Pridi, a refined text serif with small letters standing proud, feels like a courteous reply beside it.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads traditional, with counters spilling into surrounding space. Over a longer passage, its stubby ascenders and big x-height feel sturdy and refined, while Vast Shadow's uniform strokes stay up in the heading.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-slabo-13px: Vast Shadow has curves as heavy as its stems, like cord, and a tall mean line above. Slabo 13px follows as a bookish serif with open counters.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum has a c as open as a bent paperclip and a high, woodblock-like x-height. Over a longer stretch, Suwannaphum reads in a dignified, editorial way, a good foil to Vast Shadow's zero-modulation strokes.
gen-vt323-fs-literata: Commanding and cyberpunk, VT323 packs its letters tight with no hairlines anywhere, the opposite of a bookish, sophisticated Literata text serif. VT323 earns its keep in big, short headings.
